title: Demonic Path Commander
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing's words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind—blood relation to me? The mysterious commander who led the demonic army to sweep across three provinces actually has a blood connection to this useless servant of the Tianqing Sect?

text.content:
The moon hid behind layers of clouds, and the night wind cut like a blade.

Chen Ji sat alone on the ruins of a broken temple, the missing fragment of the Tianji Record in his hand glowing with a cold, eerie light. Three days had passed since the trip to the Forbidden Grounds, yet Mo Xiansheng's warning coiled in his heart like a venomous snake—don't believe a single word in the Tianji Record.

He lowered his gaze to the faintly visible prophetic words, his brow furrowed tight. Were the futures he had seen these past days guidance from destiny, or was some invisible hand manipulating him toward a predetermined chess game?

The Tianji Record never lies, but it can choose what to reveal and what to conceal. This, Chen Ji understood better than anyone.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's figure swept out from the shadows, the aura of the Demonic Path Saint flickering in the night wind) Chen Ji, you're quite leisurely. In such a time, you're still in the mood to watch the moon?

text.content:
Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record and looked at the visitor with an unchanged expression.

"Saint Lady visiting at night, I wonder what brings you here?" His tone was cold and indifferent, as if asking an unimportant passerby.

Ye Qing laughed lightly, landing on the other end of the ruins, the two of them barely three feet apart. Under the moonlight, her demonically beautiful face carried a playful look: "In three days the demonic army will arrive, and your entire Tianqing Sect is on high alert. Yet this useless servant still has the mood to admire the moon. Truly... composure in the face of chaos."

She deliberately emphasized the words "useless," trying to see some reaction on Chen Ji's face. However, that ordinary face remained calm as still water, as if she hadn't spoken mockery at all, but merely offered some insignificant pleasantry.

dialogue.content: Being useless has its benefits. (Chen Ji said calmly) If I die, it's no great loss; if I live, I don't碍眼. If the Saint Lady came to extract information from me, I'm afraid you'll be disappointed.

(A strange glint flashed in Ye Qing's eyes) You see through things clearly. No wonder you've been able to play crazy and act stupid at Tianqing Sect for so many years... But tonight I didn't come for information.

text.content:
Chen Ji raised an eyebrow, his gaze scanning across Ye Qing's face.

The Demonic Path Saint came of her own accord, yet not for information? From his understanding of this woman, every word and every action of hers carries deep meaning. After a moment of silence, he spoke: "Then why does the Saint Lady visit so late at night?"

Ye Qing looked up at the night sky, her voice suddenly dropping: "That great battle three days from now... I have something to tell you. About that mysterious commander."

Chen Ji's heart skipped half a beat, but his expression remained unchanged. He picked up the coarse tea by his side and took a shallow sip: "I'm all ears."

dialogue.content: The true commander of the demonic army is not the Holy Sect Master, nor those old monsters. (Ye Qing's voice carried a complex tone) It's a person whose name has never appeared in any Demonic Path records.

I once glimpsed fragments in the Holy Sect's secret scrolls—this person appeared only three years ago, yet has already made the entire Demonic Path bow before them. His cultivation is unfathomable, said to be related to some kind of ancient inheritance. (Her gaze fell on the fragment in Chen Ji's hand) Perhaps even... related to the Tianji Record.

text.content:
The fingers holding his teacup tightened slightly.

The Tianji Record. Ancient inheritance. Mysterious commander.

These three seemingly unrelated keywords collided in his mind, sparking a series of insights. He thought of Mo Xiansheng's words in the Forbidden Grounds, the altered prophecy, the tragic fate of past prophets being used as chess pieces.

If the demonic commander is truly related to the Tianji Record, then is he an ally or an enemy?

"This person..." Chen Ji raised his eyes, his voice still calm, "why would the Saint Lady tell me this?"

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing met his gaze, her smile carrying a hint of self-mockery) Because I'm tired of being used as a chess piece. And you... might become the key to breaking the stalemate.

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly.

"The Saint Lady overestimates me." He set down the teacup and stood, brushing dust from his robe. "I'm merely a useless person—how could I catch your attention? As for breaking stalemates... I only want to live peacefully."

His tone was light and casual, as if the bombshell news he had just heard was merely small talk about the weather today.

Yet Ye Qing was unmoved. She watched Chen Ji's back as he turned to leave, then suddenly spoke: "The timing and location of this person's appearance... almost coincides with when you obtained the Tianji Record fragment. Do you really think that's coincidence?"

Chen Ji's footsteps came to an abrupt halt.

Under the moonlight, his back stiffened for a moment. After a pause, he slowly turned around, and that ordinary face finally showed a hint of solemnity: "What exactly does the Saint Lady want to say?"

Ye Qing stepped closer, her voice dropping to an extremely low pitch: "During the battle in three days, I'll find a way to hold off the Holy Sect people. If you want to investigate the truth, this is the best opportunity."

She paused, a complex light flickering in her eyes: "That mysterious commander... might be blood-related to you."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's revelation struck like a heavy hammer against Chen Ji's defenses. Faced with this shocking secret possibly connected to his own blood, how should he respond?

choices.description: Since we've already come this far, might as well ask directly—who is the commander? Why would they be connected to me?
choices.visible_cost: Expose the Importance You Place on This Matter
choices.risk_hint: Let Ye Qing See Through Your Weaknesses

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the turbulent waves in his heart.

"Who exactly is this commander?" His voice remained steady, but his speaking pace was slightly faster than usual. "Blood relation to me... what does the Saint Lady mean by this?"

Ye Qing seemed unprepared for his directness. After a moment of surprise, she smiled: "You truly keep your composure. Very well, there's no harm in telling you—"

choices.description: The more shocking the secret, the more you must appear calm and detached. Stabilize first, then secretly find ways to investigate.
choices.visible_cost: May Miss the Window for Obtaining Intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Don't Let Ye Qing See Your Cards
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing May Stop Talking as a Result

text.content:
Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, as if Ye Qing had merely mentioned something trivial.

"Blood relation?" He laughed lightly. "The Saint Lady jests. I'm merely an orphan—where would any blood relation come from?"

Even as he spoke, his fingers tightened secretly within his sleeve. Orphan... when Master picked him up and brought him to Tianqing Sect, he truly knew nothing about himself.

choices.description: Don't respond directly; instead use vague words to test how much Ye Qing actually knows, then decide the next move.
choices.risk_hint: If Seen Through, Will Lose the Initiative

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer. Instead, he looked at Ye Qing with a thoughtful expression.

"The Saint Lady came late at night just to tell me this?" He shifted topics. "Or is this... also part of the Holy Sect's chess game?"

Ye Qing's eyes flickered, as if she hadn't expected such a counter-question.

Ye Qing's smile stiffened slightly.

She stared at Chen Ji for a moment, then suddenly sighed: "You really are as the rumors say... deeply hidden."

She did not answer Chen Ji's question directly, but turned toward the temple gate. Before leaving, her voice drifted on the wind: "During the battlefield in three days, I'll give you a chance to get close to the commander. Then you'll understand everything."

The night wind lifted her robes, and the figure of the Demonic Path Saint gradually dissolved into the darkness.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing left too many mysteries. With the battle three days away, Chen Ji must make a decision—whether to investigate this lead alone, or use her to strike back?

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to peer into information about that mysterious commander, searching for clues within the prophecies.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Critical Intelligence on the Commander
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Points are precious—consumption requires caution

text.content:
Chen Ji stood in the night wind for a long while.

Slowly, he took out the Tianji Record fragment, his fingertips gently stroking the yellowed page. Heavenly Fate Points... every time he glimpsed the future, it cost five points. How many remained, even he wasn't sure.

But if he could see through the true face of that commander...

He took a deep breath, about to activate the heavenly secrets power, when Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang in his mind: "You still want to trust it?"

choices.description: Mobilize the pieces you've planted everywhere to comprehensively investigate the commander's identity and origins.
choices.visible_reward: Does Not Consume Heavenly Fate Points, Obtain More Comprehensive Intelligence Network
choices.risk_hint: Once Exposed, Will Lose Important Intelligence Source

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew the Tianji Record, a sharp light flickering in his eyes.

Investigation can happen without it. All these years, he had laid out pieces across the world, countless hidden pawns. From the three major sects to inside the Demonic Path, he had planted nails everywhere.

He closed his eyes, and his fingers lightly knocked three times within his sleeve—this was the code to activate the highest-level intelligence network.

"Investigate everything about the Demonic Path commander. Within three days, I want to know his name, origins, and..." He paused. "Whether he is related to the Chen family."

choices.description: Su Qingyao is the only person who has sensed something off about him—perhaps she can provide a different perspective from the Inner Sect.
choices.visible_cost: May Expose More Information to Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Inner Sect Perspective Intelligence, While Deepening Connection with Su Qingyao
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao Already Has Suspicions About Him

text.content:
Chen Ji paced in place for a moment, then suddenly turned and darted toward the direction of the Inner Sect.

Su Qingyao... that woman was like a keen-nosed hound, repeatedly almost piercing through his disguise. But he had to admit, the information she possessed was more comprehensive than his.

The position of Inner Disciple Senior Fellow gave her access to the sect's most core classics and secret accounts. Perhaps she knew something he didn't.

The night wind grew colder, and the moon had already sunk toward the west.

Chen Ji stood in the ruined temple for a long while, replaying Ye Qing's words endlessly in his mind. Related to the Tianji Record... related to blood... these two threads intertwined, allowing him to vaguely touch upon some shocking outline.

He suddenly remembered something Mo Xiansheng had once said: "The inheritance of the Tianji Record is never randomly selected."

Could it be... that mysterious commander is also one of the candidates for the Tianji Record?

Just then, the Tianji Record suddenly lit up on its own.

Chen Ji lowered his gaze to see faint words emerge on the yellowed page—

"Commander Appears, Heavenly Secrets in Chaos. Blood Relatives Meet, Fates Destroy Each Other."

Sixteen characters, each word like a blade.

Chen Ji stared at the line for a long while, then suddenly laughed softly. His shoulders shook with laughter, his eyes grew red.

"Blood relatives... fates destroy each other..." His voice was hoarse. "This game of chess, it seems we truly must play to the end."

The radiance of the Tianji Record faded slowly, and those words vanished as well. But Chen Ji knew, the true storm was only beginning.
